about.label: About
about.headline: From Biology to Code, From Lab to Product
about.p1: Biomedical Engineer finishing at UNC Córdoba. My thesis — TraumaVision — detects bone fractures in X-rays with 97.18% accuracy and Recall 86.6%. Clinical-grade AI, built from scratch.
about.p2: In 2026 I founded Eleven: an AI-native digital agency. 38-agent coordinated pipeline, Claude API at its core, 4 products live in production.
about.p3: 1st place at Rocking the Industry — world's first industrial hackathon by RTS Group. 150 multidisciplinary teams. Team Algarroba LID.
about.p4: 24 years old. Córdoba, Argentina. 8 months working in California — that's where I actually learned English.

traumavision.label: Thesis Project — UNC Córdoba, 2025
traumavision.title: TraumaVision AI
traumavision.subtitle: Clinical Decision Support System for Fracture Detection in X-Rays
traumavision.description: End-to-end CDSS for fracture detection in X-ray images. 97.18% accuracy, 86.6% sensitivity, AUC-ROC 0.973. Currently competing in entrepreneurship programs (EmprendeU and others) seeking investment to launch TraumaVision to market.

Argentina, 2026.

hackathon.title: Rocking the Industry
hackathon.subtitle: Industrial Hackathon — RTS Group
hackathon.description: World's first industrial hackathon by RTS Group. 150 multidisciplinary teams of 5 people each. Team Algarroba LID placed first.
hackathon.description_expanded: World's first industrial hackathon, organized by RTS Group. 150 multidisciplinary teams of 5 people competing in real industrial engineering challenges. Team Algarroba LID took first place with a proposal for automating human-in-the-loop agents for sensor control in a nuclear power plant.

items.description: Founded and operate an AI-native digital agency. 38-agent coordinated pipeline — discovery, strategy, brand, dev, QA. 4 products live in production. AI-generated digital content for clients.

Corrective and preventive maintenance of biomedical equipment at Sanatorio Allende (JCI accreditation process). Sectors: adult ICU/CCU, OR, pediatric ICU, NICU, endoscopy, wards, outpatient. Equipment: defibrillators (Philips/Feas), multiparametric monitors, infusion pumps (Braun), surgical tables (Steris), incubators (Medix/Atom), IABP Datascope, endoscopes, fetal monitors, ECG/SpO2/capnography. Calibrations with Fluke. Inventory traceability with Neovero CMMS.

items.company: UNC — Faculty of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences
items.description: Teaching assistant for Human Physiology at the Faculty of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences, UNC. Supported theoretical and practical classes, exam preparation, and student mentoring.
8 months in customer service at Snow Summit, Big Bear Lake, California — entirely in English. That's where I actually learned the language.
